title: Trinket.io shutting down, so we saved it and hosted it a trinket.strivemath.org
summary: Trinket.io, a popular browser-based Python coding platform for education, was shutting down and a community member saved the project and self-hosted it at trinket.strivemath.org to preserve access for students and educators.
problem_solved: Preserves access to a widely-used educational coding platform that was being discontinued, preventing loss of valuable learning resources.
why_valuable: Community-driven preservation of educational infrastructure ensures students and teachers can continue using a trusted tool for learning Python coding.
